snapshot.limitations: 100 synthetic development cases with specification-authored labels; not real customer data, prevalence, calibrated confidence, or generalized accuracy. Reference validity is not applicable to intake classification. Historical evaluator route is unchanged for comparison.

timingSummary.limitation: No historical provider-side baseline exists. Missing values are excluded with explicit counts, never imputed to zero; all cases remain in official end-to-end metrics.
